insight: There's been no measurable rain lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The model's main signals right now: hours since high tide is lowering risk — the timing relative to high tide affects how concentrated bacteria are at the shoreline; the lack of recent rain is keeping runoff-driven contamination low; and onshore wave energy is raising risk — onshore wave energy drives water — and any plume — toward the beach. The most recent sample, 4 days ago, was excellent at 5 MPN/100mL.
